payload_shape.record: the final result record with record_validation_receipt_sha256 removed

canonicalization.object_keys: recursively sort by ECMAScript default Array.prototype.sort UTF-16 code-unit order
canonicalization.serialization: JSON.stringify with no replacer and no whitespace, then append exactly one LF
canonicalization.numbers: finite JSON numbers only; reject negative zero and non-finite values before serialization
canonicalization.digest: SHA-256 of the serialized UTF-8 bytes

rules: All final record fields except the one removed pointer are populated and immutable before semantic validation.

The semantic validator validates and hashes this detached projection, then emits a controller-owned receipt containing the projection digest and every recomputed invariant; the receipt content never contains its own artifact hash.

The controller separately hashes the completed receipt artifact and inserts that hash into record_validation_receipt_sha256; reconstructing this projection from the stored final record must remain byte-for-byte identical.
Reject any schema-unknown field or any additional field whose treatment is not defined by this contract.
